description: Defines CUDA interprocess communication (IPC) data structures, functions, and constants for managing shared CUDA memory and events within the PyTorch framework.

classes.name: CudaIPCSentDataLimbo
classes.description: Manages data blocks with non-zero reference counters that are to be deleted.

classes.name: CudaIPCRefCountersFile
classes.description: Handles reference counters stored in shared memory for CUDA IPC.

classes.name: CudaIPCCollectCallback
classes.description: Callback class to trigger CUDA IPC collection.

methods.name: CudaIPCReceivedData
methods.description: Constructor initializing shared pointer data for received IPC data.

methods.name: CudaIPCSentData
methods.description: Constructor and destructor managing sent IPC data, including handle, offset, and device info.

methods.name: counter_value
methods.description: Returns the current reference counter value.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Returns the handle string for IPC data.

methods.name: GetNewRefCountedSentData
methods.description: Creates new reference-counted sent data for CUDA IPC.

methods.name: collect
methods.description: Collects and cleans up IPC data blocks.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a shared data block to the limbo.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of data blocks in limbo.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the CUDA IPC collection callback.
